author: claude
summary: Task 007 of the voice-card-consolidation plan: adds a pre-recording archetype/attribute picker (6 matcher-relevant fields only) and a live 'read this aloud' cue card driven by the existing, unmodified `suggestRecordingPrompt()`. Wires both into SamplesTab as a new Upload | Record mode toggle -- Record mode shows the picker + cue card ahead of the actual capture UI (record/stop/level-meter controls land in task 008).

files.change: New component. Reduced picker exposing ONLY class/gender/age/pace (OneSelect) and tone/timbre (ManySelect) -- the 6 fields scoreArchetype() actually uses -- reusing the existing OneSelect/ManySelect components and getSection() lookup from Voices/components/metadata/taxonomy.ts. Includes a Skip button (onSkip callback).

New component. Calls suggestRecordingPrompt(attrs) unmodified. Since suggestRecordingPrompt() returns null for the true zero-selection case (hasMeaningfulAttrs gate) -- distinct from composeFallback(), which only runs once some attrs are set but none score a close match, and always returns a real prompt -- this component supplies its own GENERIC_SKIP_PROMPT/GENERIC_SKIP_DIRECTION strings for that null case so the card never renders empty.

Added an Upload | Record mode toggle (role=tablist). Upload mode is unchanged (renders SamplesSection). Record mode renders ArchetypePicker (state-lifted ArchetypeAttrs) + RecordingCueCard, with a Skip flag that switches the cue card to the zero-selection generic prompt path. Leaves a comment marking where task 008's capture UI (record/stop/level-meter) will mount below the cue card.

Added minimal styling for the new samples-tab__mode-toggle, samples-tab__record-mode, archetype-picker, archetype-picker__skip-btn, and recording-cue-card(__prompt/__direction) classes, following the existing metadata-editor class conventions in this file.

New tests: picker renders exactly the 6 matcher-relevant field labels and not the other 5 taxonomy sections; Skip button fires onSkip; selecting a value (Class=Human) updates a connected RecordingCueCard's rendered prompt away from the generic skip prompt.

New tests covering all three suggestRecordingPrompt confidence tiers (exact archetype match via recordingArchetypes[0]'s own attrs, composed fallback via a partial attrs set with no close match) plus the true zero-selection Skip case, asserting a real generic prompt is rendered (not empty/null) and that it differs from composeFallback's untagged-voice text.
